title: Austin Officials Sworn In, Mayor Pro Tem Chosen
meeting_type: Austin City Council Special Called Meeting
summary:
*   **New Leadership Sworn In:** Newly elected City officials, including the Mayor, took their oaths of office for various Council positions.
*   **Mayor Pro Tem Selected:** An election was held to choose the new Mayor Pro Tem from among the Council members.
*   **Focused Special Meeting:** This brief special session was dedicated solely to these essential organizational tasks.
transcript:
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING 
 
Monday, June 25, 2012 
The Austin City Council will convene at 6:00 PM on 
Monday, June 25, 2012 at Austin City Hall 
301 W. Second Street, Austin, TX 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Mayor Lee Leffingwell 
Council Member Chris Riley, Place 1 
Council Member Mike Martinez, Place 2 
Council Member Kathie Tovo, Place 3 
Council Member Laura Morrison, Place 4 
Council Member William Spelman, Place 5 
Council Member Sheryl Cole, Place 6 
 
 
 
 
For meeting information, contact the City Clerk, 974-2210 
 
 
 
The City Council will go into a closed session under Chapter 551 of the Texas Government Code 
to receive advice from legal counsel, to discuss matters of land acquisition, to discuss personnel matters, 
to discuss or take action on a “competitive matter” of Austin Energy as provided for 
under Section 551.086, or for other reasons permitted by law as specifically listed on this agenda. 
If necessary, the City Council may go into a closed session as permitted by law regarding any item on this agenda.  
 
Administration of the Oath of Office to the newly elected Council Members for Mayor, Place Two,
